value.rationale: The 5-fold cyclic genus-four cover with four branch points is a canonical one-dimensional family identified in cyclic-cover Newton-polygon literature; p=31 is a natural congruence case p≡1 mod15. The explicit doubled Hasse equation isolates exactly its nonordinary marked locus. Its distinguished exceptional curve carries a specific, nontrivial simple four-dimensional nonordinary Jacobian with a fully determined Weil polynomial; this structural arithmetic datum can be used to study its isogeny class and twists. It is more than a routine restatement of the known mass formula or a random small numerical count.
